_about: Defaults for one developer or agency. Copy to profile.local.json (git ignores it) and fill it in. The skill reads it at intake; the site's own answers win.
developer: Your name (test leads are named 'TEST <developer> - please ignore')
_level_about: "new": plain words, every term explained once, exact clicks, "Your turn" at the end of each message. "developer": short and technical.
_oks_about: "group": one OK covers a listed batch of downloads and installs, each named with its source and size. "each": every download and install is asked on its own. Deletes and live steps are always asked one at a time.
reply_style: One step at a time for manual steps; wait for 'done'.

local._about: Where WordPress runs on this computer. Leave it empty: doctor.py finds your local tool (Laragon, XAMPP, MAMP, WampServer, Local, Herd, DDEV, wp-env or a native setup) and fills this in with your OK.

host._about: Where sites go live. cPanel with Duplicator Pro is the kit's default; other hosts work too (references/launch.md).

tracking.method: GTM container in the head and the noscript after <body>

_extra_plugins_about: Plugins of your own or your agency's, on top of the kit's defaults (ACF PRO, Contact Form 7, Yoast SEO; Redirection if needed; Duplicator Pro; Converter for Media and Contact Form CFDB7 on live). "required": true = installed in S1-02 with the starter plugins and kept active on live; the others when their "when" says. Never installed without an OK.

extra_plugins.name: Your agency's plugin
extra_plugins.when: S1-02, live, or a later task
extra_plugins.source: where it comes from (a zip path, or the developer installs it)

plugin_zips._about: Paths on this machine to plugin zips you bought (never the licence keys: those go in each site's wp-config.php, pasted by you).

branding._about: Agency badge in the footer of the lead email AND the auto-reply (both use the same branded HTML template). A PNG at 2x size (email clients do not show SVG or WebP); a white badge sits on the brand-colour footer strip. Path relative to the skill folder or absolute; empty = no badge.
branding._site_badge_about: The same badge for the site footer's bottom bar (SVG is fine on the web): kitwp_agency_badge(). Theme Settings > Branding can swap or hide it.

leads_portal._about: A leads portal that gets every sent lead form, server to server (JSON, Bearer key). wp-config holds <constant_prefix>_ENDPOINT and <constant_prefix>_KEY (the developer pastes them; never in the theme). Off on local, development and staging. Empty prefix: no portal.
